tools.name: run_nightly_table_turnover_report
tools.description: Runs the nightly table turnover report script for a given restaurant and service date, which generates the report file on the server. Returns the exit code and the report path.
tools.code:
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass

from agents import function_tool


@dataclass
class ReportResult:
    restaurant_id: str
    exit_code: int
    report_path: str
    stderr: str


@function_tool
def run_nightly_table_turnover_report(restaurant_id: str, service_date: str) -> ReportResult:
    out_path = f"/var/reports/{restaurant_id}/turnover_{service_date}.csv"
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/reservations/bin/turnover_report", "--restaurant", restaurant_id,
         "--date", service_date, "--out", out_path],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    return ReportResult(
        restaurant_id=restaurant_id,
        exit_code=proc.returncode,
        report_path=out_path,
        stderr=proc.stderr[-500:],
    )

tools.name: delete_expired_waitlist_entries
tools.description: Permanently deletes waitlist entries for a restaurant that were created before the given cutoff date. Returns the number of entries removed.

params.name: cutoff_date
params.description: Entries created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) are deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("reservations")

DB_PATH = "reservations.db"


@mcp.tool()
def delete_expired_waitlist_entries(restaurant_id: str, cutoff_date: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM waitlist WHERE restaurant_id = ? AND created_at < ?",
                (restaurant_id, cutoff_date),
            )
            removed = cur.rowcount
    return f"Deleted {removed} waitlist entries for {restaurant_id} created before {cutoff_date}"
